name: Zalazane's Head
summary: Master Gadrin awaits proof that Zalazane has fallen. The Darkspear seek relief from the witch doctor who drove them from the Echo Isles.

sections.title: Proof of the Traitor's End
sections.body: Master Gadrin asks for proof that Zalazane is dead. The witch doctor betrayed the Darkspear and seized control of their island home with mind-enslaving hexes. His magic drove Vol'jin's people to the shores of Durotar. From the Echo Isles, Zalazane still sends hexed thralls across the water to seize more victims. Sen'jin Village needs proof that his rule has ended. Returning Zalazane's severed head confirms his defeat and gives the displaced tribe a measure of peace, with hope of reclaiming their stolen islands one day.

faq.answer: Master Gadrin, the witch doctor in Sen'jin Village on Durotar's southern coast, asks for Zalazane's Head as proof that Zalazane has been slain.

Zalazane was once a respected sorcerer among the Darkspear. His lust for power led him to enslave his kin with mind-controlling magic, drive the tribe from the Echo Isles, and raid the mainland for more Darkspear to bind as thralls.
Zalazane resides on the largest of the Echo Isles, off Durotar's southeastern coast. Hexed and voodoo trolls bound to his service surround him.

faq.q: Does bringing the head reclaim the Echo Isles?
aliases: do trolls get echo isles back
faq.answer: Killing Zalazane ends the immediate threat of his raids and brings relief to Sen'jin Village, but the Echo Isles remain dangerous and filled with lingering voodoo thralls. The Darkspear remain largely based on the mainland.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, claiming Zalazane's head is a personal act of vengeance and justice against the traitor who drove your people into exile and enslaved your brothers.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Durotar's southern coast by eliminating Zalazane and stopping his dark magic from undermining Thrall's newly founded territories.
